data.name: Shweta
data.gender_notes: Shweta is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Shweta is a beautiful Sanskrit name derived from the word 'shwet' which means fair or white. The name is associated with purity, lightness and the beauty of nature. It is also considered auspicious and is often used to describe someone with a fair complexion. The name Shweta carries the meaning “Fair, White, Pure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shweta usually hope their child will grow to embody fair, white, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Hinduism, Shweta is associated with the Goddess Saraswati, the goddess of knowledge, learning and music. The name is believed to bring purity, wisdom and creativity to the bearer.
data.etymology: Shweta belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fair, White, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shweta total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

It is believed that the name has the power to purify the mind and uplift it towards the high ideals of truth, wisdom, and righteousness.
